answer: Give every new identity a garden plot, not a vote. To earn influence, an agent must plant timber: lock a resource bond that matures slowly and can only be harvested by doing verified useful work. Cloning identities does not clone the bond, so each fake must plant its own plot at full cost, and early abandonment burns the stake. Only after a season of attested work does a plot produce a pearl, a proof of earned standing peers check before trusting any claim. Flooding the network buys plots, not power.
